$comment: Perf-gate profile of phase P3 (run-perf-gate.ps1 -Profile p3). Specs run as they are; templates are materialized with the variables below (from -Var NAME=value, -Slot / -Clip / -AppData, or SIGIL_BENCH_<NAME> environment variables) and skipped with a warning when a required one is missing (-Strict makes that an error). Targets are the plan's T1-T9 rows the benchmark can measure (docs/SPEECH_STACK_IMPLEMENTATION_PLAN.md, 'VC best engine' > Targets): gate = true rows fail the gate when missed (P3 exit: T2, T3, T5, T7, T9 on H2 with the load simulator); gate = false rows are reported only (H1 / H3 rows are provisional until a live-record run exists, and rows that need extra inputs). Per-block compute is `call_ms` (the worker time of the device blocks that ran the model): a fixed-block engine converts one 40 ms block every few device blocks, and `block_ms` over every device block would be dominated by the accumulating ones. H2 is the dev rig with the load simulator at 70 % duty, so the gating T2 rows read the `h2-load70` run; the idle `offline` rows are advisory (and feed the context-scaling ratio, a property of the engine itself).
